tables.title: DCMIPP_P0DCCNTR and DCMIPP_P0DCLMTR bit function
tables.text: Table 341, "DCMIPP_P0DCCNTR and DCMIPP_P0DCLMTR bit function", in section 39.5.5 (Dump counter) on page 1844. Columns: Bit ID, Function. 4 data row(s).

rows:
Read-only, counts the amount of data with a 4-byte granularity for most of the input 
formats or with an 8-bit data granularity in JPEG byte stream mode selected into 
DCMIPP_PRCR.FORMAT). The counter increment is based on dumped data at the 
pipe output standpoint. The value is expressed in bytes, whatever the input format.

Gives the maximum amount of 32-bit data that can be dumped. Limit value 0 is 
inconsistent and the processed frame is not guaranteed if ENABLE bit is set.
